title: Frobenius Structures on Tame Hecke Eigensheaves
summary: We construct nonzero perverse Weil Hecke eigensheaves for SL n with Borel level at one marked point, after a finite extension of the field of constants. The parameter is a geometrically dense arithmetic PGL n -local system with tame regular-unipotent monodromy on a once-punctured curve of genus at least two over a finite field of characteristic p > n . The full multi-leg eigenstructure is Frobenius compatible with the prescribed arithmetic eigenvalue, and the geometric sheaf has parabolic nilpotent singular support.
family_title: Restricted geometric Langlands, global Arthur enhancements, and generic Ramanujan

review.reason: Constructs Hecke eigensheaves for SL_n with Frobenius structure over finite fields.
